doc.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Nat Cole as a jazz pianist
summary: Hendricks praises Nat Cole as a top jazz pianist he met through Art Tatum.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I didn’t know that. I didn’t know – I know about his – more of his ballad- type work.
Oh no. He was a jazz piano player before he started singing. He started singing accidentally.
He was one of the ten best jazz pianists. He could play. I met him, because I was working in Toledo with Art, and he’d come to see Art. That’s how we met. But he was a great jazz musician, very hip.
